messages:
annie: heads-up — onboarding Scallop's LoRA merge into the int4 build. quick smoke before we hand off to infra.
mike: what was the base model again? cust asked for gptx-7b-ish open checkpoint
annie: gptx-7b-v2 + Scallop-lora-v1. merge went fine in fp32, issues show up only after int4 quant.
soma: summary of failures?
annie: short: token probabilities for amounts and product names shift, and some prompts truncate earlier. small repro attached below.
annie: repro prompt: \n```
User: "Charge $49.99 to the customer's card for order #A-2243"
Assistant:
```
mike: outputs in fp32 look fine: "Charged $49.99 to ...". int4 output flips digits or drops cents sometimes.
annie: example int4 output snapshot: "Charged $499 to the customer's card for order #A-2243" — missing dot, magnitude wrong.
jonah: that's worrying. sounds like tokenizer id remap or embedding quant noise. did we run the tokenizer sanity check after merge?
soma: ran tokenmap-check.sh, found a few token id collisions in merged adapter's vocabulary remap layer — mostly punctuation-adjacent tokens.
annie: log snippet: \n```
2026-03-21T15:01:02Z WARN tokenmap: remap collision for token " ." ids [421, 921]
2026-03-21T15:01:02Z INFO quant: per-channel scale variance > thresh on layer 26
```
mike: could be that int4 per-channel scales exaggerated the collision effect. We should run quick eval pack (30 samples) with metrics: EM, token-error-rate, and a calibrated threshold for numeric magnitudes.
annie: started a quickpack job -> run id qpack-1713456945. command: \n```
./run_quickpack --model gptx-7b-v2-int4 --adapter Scallop-lora-v1 --samples 30 --metrics em,ter,num-mse --out /tmp/qpack-1713456945.json
```
deploy-bot: Quickpack qpack-1713456945 queued on runner-8. ETA ~4m
jonah: if tokenmap collisions are the root, temporary mitigation: apply adapter-side token remap patch that maps conflicting tokens to canonical ids before merge. low-risk and quick to test.
soma: I pushed a small patch to patch/token-remap-fix branch. it inserts a deterministic remap table and re-runs merge. sha: b3f9c2. re-run int4 quant now.
annie: new quickpack results (summary): EM down from 0.96 -> 0.88 on int4 before fix; after remap fix int4 EM -> 0.94. token-error-rate dropped from 0.12 -> 0.03. numeric MSE reduced by 6x.
mike: nice. still some tail cases where long order ids (>10 chars) get clipped. could be KV-cache alignment with quantized attention weights.
jonah: create a follow-up evalset focusing on long identifiers and currency formats. also add a fallback plan: route heavy numeric flows to fp16 Dedicated variant for Scallop until scheduled full validation.
annie: +1. file a rollout policy: canary 5% to fp16 fallback for routes /billing/*, auto-rollback on <0.98 EM regression.
annie: tagging eng-platform and infra for Dedicated route config next week.
soma: notes saved in quickpack artifact /artifacts/qpack-1713456945/summary.json
annie: thanks all — i'll draft a short note for the customer about temporary fallback and ETA for final sign-off (~48h). :thumbsup:
